item.title: ELLE Weaves: Inside ituvana’s Habutai Silk Collection
item.description: For this edition of ELLE Weaves, the spotlight is on material first. The collection from ituvana is built around one fabric, Habutai silk, and understanding it requires going back to the very beginning of how silk is made. View this post on Instagram A post shared by ELLE India (@elleindia) The process starts with sericulture. Silkworms are raised on a steady diet of mulberry leaves. Their growth cycle is carefully monitored because the quality of the cocoon determines the quality of the fibre.
